# Shapiro

> Shapiro provides comprehensive organic waste recycling and sustainable disposal solutions, converting food waste and agricultural byproducts into renewable energy and valuable resources across North America.

Based in New Bedford, MA and operating the Linden Renewable Energy Project in New Jersey, Shapiro Enterprises specializes in turnkey waste management solutions for commercial, agricultural, and industrial clients. The company combines anaerobic digestion technology with circular economy principles to divert organic waste from landfills while generating renewable energy.

## Core Waste Recycling Services

- [Food Waste Recycling](https://shapiroe.com/food-waste-recycling): End-to-end commercial food waste recycling solutions with renewable energy conversion
- [Beverage Destruction & Recycling](https://shapiroe.com/beverage-destruction): Certified beverage destruction service for expired, recalled, and surplus beverages nationwide
- [Liquid Waste Disposal](https://shapiroe.com/liquid-waste-disposal): Reliable liquid waste management, disposal, and logistics services nationwide
- [Food By-Products Recycling](https://shapiroe.com/food-byproducts-recycling): Food by-product recycling and disposal services for circular economy benefits
- [Alcohol & Ethanol Recycling](https://shapiroe.com/alcohol-disposal): Eco-friendly alcohol and ethanol recycling services for safe, cost-effective disposal
- [Agricultural Waste Solutions](https://shapiroe.com/agricultural-waste-solutions): Large-scale farm waste management and feedstock recycling solutions
- [Biochar Production](https://shapiroe.com/biochar-solutions): Commercial biochar production for soil enhancement and waste management solutions
